# 2 Baruch Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** The Lord said to me: "This city will be handed over for a while. The people will be disciplined for a while. But the world will not be forgotten.

**2** Do you think this is the city God meant when he said, 'I have engraved you on the palms of my hands'? The building standing before you now is not the real Jerusalem. The real one is in my keeping — it was prepared before I even created Paradise.

**3** I showed it to Adam before he sinned. When he disobeyed my command, it was taken away from him, just as Paradise was.

**4** Afterward I showed it to Abraham during the night when he laid out the sacrifice pieces.

**5** I showed it again to Moses on Sinai, when I showed him the pattern of the tabernacle and all its furnishings.

**6** Right now it is hidden with me, along with Paradise. But it will be revealed when my Messiah begins to appear.

**7** So do not be troubled by what is happening now. It does not come from your sins — it is preparation for what is coming."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Discipline" for "chasten." The pre-existent heavenly Jerusalem theology rendered for clarity. "Pattern" for "likeness of the tabernacle" echoes Heb 8:5. "Messiah" for "Anointed One" is preferred for modern readers.*
